 1               P R O C E E D I N G S

 2                ACTING PRESIDENT BONACIC:   The 

 3   Senate will come to order.  

 4                I ask everyone present to please 

 5   rise and repeat with me the Pledge of 

 6   Allegiance.

 7                (Whereupon, the assemblage recited 

 8   the Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag.)

 9                ACTING PRESIDENT BONACIC:   We are 

10   joined today by Reverend Dennis Campbell, of 

11   United Community Baptist Church in Brooklyn.  

12                Reverend.  

13                REVEREND CAMPBELL:   I am honored 

14   and delighted to be here and to be asked to give 

15   the invocation.  

16                I just want to say thanks to 

17   Senator Kevin Parker of the 21st District, where 

18   United Community Baptist Church is located.  

19                It is in this spirit that I greet 

20   all who are here today.  Let us pray.

21                Almighty and Ever-Living God, in 

22   whom we live and move and have our being, we bow 

23   humbly before You this morning.  We give You 

24   thanks, O Lord, for Your goodness at all times 

25   and in all places.  


                                                                1190

 1                Open our eyes that we may behold 

 2   Your Fatherly presence about us.  Draw our 

 3   hearts unto You with the power of Your love.  

 4   Teach us, O God our Father, to be anxious for 

 5   nothing.  

 6                And when we have done all that 

 7   You've asked us to do, help us to leave the 

 8   issue to Your infinite wisdom.  We acknowledge 

 9   that You are the only one who can rightly lead 

10   and guide Your people.  

11                We pray, Holy Father, for Your 

12   blessings upon these assembled in this chamber, 

13   especially for the men and women who have been 

14   given the awesome responsibility to conduct the 

15   affairs of this great state.  Grant them wisdom 

16   and strength that they may serve always with 

17   dignity, conviction, and humility.  

18                When in the execution of their 

19   duties they encounter difficult and challenging 

20   situations, help them, we pray, to hold onto 

21   their sense of perspective.  

22                Guide them, O Lord, we beseech You, 

23   with the power of Your spirit, and sustain them 

24   with the strength of Your divine grace, that 

25   they may overcome every obstacle that stands in 


                                                                1191

 1   the way of progress and remain steadfast in 

 2   their commitment to uphold the principles of 

 3   truth, justice, and liberty.

 4                Give them clarity of mind, strength 

 5   of purpose, and firmness of will as they seek to 

 6   carry out their individual and collective 

 7   responsibilities.  Help them in their 

 8   deliberation to be courteous and generous, brave 

 9   and able, dutiful and faithful.  

10                And, O Lord, may Your presence be 

11   with them, may Your spirit guide them, and may 

12   Your grace sustain them now and always.  

13                These mercies we ask in Your name 

14   and for Your glory.  Amen.

13   favor of adopting the Resolution Calendar signify

17   nay.

18                (No response.)

19                ACTING PRESIDENT BONACIC:   The 

20   Resolution Calendar is adopted.

21                Senator Libous.

 2   Secretary will read.

 3                THE SECRETARY:   Calendar Number 49, 

 4   by Senator Fuschillo, Senate Print 773, an act to 

 5   amend the Public Health Law.

 6                ACTING PRESIDENT BONACIC:   Read the 

 7   last section.

 8                THE SECRETARY:   Section 2.  This 

 9   act shall take effect immediately.

10                ACTING PRESIDENT BONACIC:   Call the 

11   roll.

12                (The Secretary called the roll.)

13                ACTING PRESIDENT BONACIC:   Announce 

14   the results.

15                THE SECRETARY:   In relation to 

16   Calendar Number 49, those recorded in the 

17   negative are Senators Avella, Espaillat, 

18   Gianaris, Hoylman, Krueger, Montgomery, Peralta, 

19   Perkins, Rivera, Sampson, Sanders, Serrano, 

20   Squadron and Stavisky.

21                Ayes, 46.  Nays, 14.

22                ACTING PRESIDENT BONACIC:   The bill 

23   is passed.

24                THE SECRETARY:   Calendar Number 52, 

25   by Senator Golden --


                                                                1194

 1                SENATOR LIBOUS:   Lay that bill 

 2   aside for the day, please.

 3                ACTING PRESIDENT BONACIC:   The bill 

 4   is laid aside for the day.

 5                THE SECRETARY:   Calendar Number 

 6   194, by Senator Golden, Senate Print 2098, an act 

 7   to amend the Penal Law.

 8                ACTING PRESIDENT BONACIC:   Read the 

 9   last section.

10                THE SECRETARY:   Section 2.  This 

11   act shall take effect on the first of November.

12                ACTING PRESIDENT BONACIC:   Call the 

13   roll.

14                (The Secretary called the roll.)

15                THE SECRETARY:   Ayes, 60.

16                ACTING PRESIDENT BONACIC:   The bill 

17   is passed.

19   reading of the calendar.
